question.text: Which of the following is incorrect?

options.text: <math><mi mathvariant="normal">F</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">e</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">l</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub></math>  is used in detection of phenol
Fehling solution is used in detection of glucose
Tollen's reagent is used in detection of unsaturation

<math><mi mathvariant="normal">N</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">S</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub></math>  is used in detection of carbonyl compound

solution.text:
Tollen's reagent is a solutionof ammoniacal silver nitrate and used for the detection of -CHO group. Aldehydes reduce Tollen's reagent and itself get oxidised to give Ag+ ions to Ag powder which forms the silver coloured mirror in the test tube. So this test is also known as silver mirror test.

R−CHOPowder+AgNH32+→R−COO−+Ag
